Aarushi Singh is a UI/UX and graphic designer based in India, currently working as a Visual Designer for Prime Video & Amazon MGM Studios (via Motion Story), delivering brand and digital creative across cross-functional teams.

Before that, she spent over a year freelancing across industries — logos, packaging, social content and product UI — after training in UI/UX and graphic design fundamentals at Dice Academy.

She works primarily in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite, alongside AI-assisted tools like Midjourney and Runway, balancing strong aesthetics with everyday usability.

Open to freelance & full-time work — let's talk →
